dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。こちらこそ、宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good morning. Likewise, thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、もしご準備大丈夫なようでしたら始めさせていただきたいのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We're a little early, but if you're ready, I'd like to begin. Would that be alright?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それでは始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Then let's begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はよくお越しくださいました。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you very much for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしければ年齢と性別を教えていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40代　主婦です。
dialogue.English: I’m in my 40s, a homemaker.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなことをご相談されますか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 毎日の食事を気をつけていて、グルテンフリー をしています。
dialogue.English: I'm being careful with our daily meals and we're following a gluten-free diet.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 子供が発達障害があり、グルテンフリー が効果的という理由からです。
dialogue.English: It's because my child has a developmental disability, and I've heard that a gluten-free diet can be effective.

dialogue.content: 子供はパンやピザが大好きなのですが、脳に良くないとよく聞きます
dialogue.English: My child loves bread and pizza, but I often hear they’re not good for the brain.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。お子様のためにそうされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're doing this for your child's sake.

dialogue.content: 少しでも子供の困り事を減らしてやりたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I want to reduce my child's difficulties, even just a little.

dialogue.content: ですが、小麦は何にでも入っていて、抜くのがものすごく大変なんです
dialogue.English: But wheat is in almost everything, and cutting it out is extremely hard.

dialogue.content: 全て手作りで無ければならないし、調味料もグルテンフリー の物は高額なんで
dialogue.English: I have to make everything from scratch, and gluten-free seasonings are expensive.

dialogue.content: 長続きしないんです
dialogue.English: It's hard to stick with it.

dialogue.content: ええ、これから先のことを考えると、親としては心配ですよね。ただ実際やるとなると手も大変だったのですね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, as a parent, it's natural to worry about the future. But it sounds like putting it into practice has been very difficult...

dialogue.content: でもすぐ、やっぱりもう少し頑張ってみようと、またやり始めるんですが、負担が大きいです
dialogue.English: But I soon start again, thinking I should just try a little harder, but it's a huge burden.

dialogue.content: ええ、金額的にも労力的にも大変だと、なかなかしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, when it's demanding both financially and in terms of effort, it can be quite draining, can't it?

dialogue.content: パンも食べないのは可哀想だと思い、米粉パンを買っても高額だし、子供は小麦のパンの方が好きみたいで、
dialogue.English: I feel bad that my child can't eat bread, and while rice-flour bread is an option, it's expensive, and my child seems to prefer wheat bread anyway.

dialogue.content: 我慢して、それもストレスらしいです。
dialogue.English: Having to put up with it seems to be a source of stress for them, too.

dialogue.content: お子さんのためとはいえ、お子さんの気持ちの方も考えると心苦しかったりしますよね。
dialogue.English: Even though it’s for your child, when you consider their feelings, it must be painful for you.

dialogue.content: はい、パスタもグルテンフリー の物は、ブチブチ切れて、美味しくないですが、
dialogue.English: Yes, and gluten-free pasta breaks apart easily and doesn't taste good.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 高くて美味しくない物を食べているのは、正直私も辛いです
dialogue.English: To be honest, it's hard for me too, eating expensive food that doesn't taste good.

dialogue.content: ええ、せっかくの食事の時間なので、家族と一緒に楽しみたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, mealtime is a special time, so you'd want to enjoy it with your family, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: はい効果もそれほど変化がわからないですが、やっぱりグルテンフリー を辞めようとは思えないんです
dialogue.English: Yes, and I can't see much of a change in terms of effect, but I still can't bring myself to stop the gluten-free diet.

dialogue.content: やめる事が怖いというか…
dialogue.English: It's like I'm scared to stop...

dialogue.content: それほどお子さんのことを心配されているのですよね。
dialogue.English: That shows just how much you worry about your child.

dialogue.content: はい、できれば身体に良い物を食べさせてやりたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, if possible, I want to feed them healthy food.

dialogue.content: ええ、健やかに育ってほしいですものね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you want them to grow up healthy.

dialogue.content: 怖いとの気持ちですが、例えばどういうことが怖いと感じているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned feeling scared. What specifically do you feel scared about?

dialogue.content: 子供にどのような影響があるか…というところでしょうか。身の回りは小麦ばかりですので…
dialogue.English: I suppose it’s about what kind of impact it might have on my child... Wheat is all around us...

dialogue.content: 全部抜いた状態で、暫く続けて、もし改善できるのなら、
dialogue.English: If we could cut it out completely and keep at it for a while, and if that could lead to improvement,

dialogue.content: 子供にとって良い状態になるかと思います
dialogue.English: I think it would be better for my child.

dialogue.content: 今は、やったりやらなかったりですので、変化もわかりにくいです
dialogue.English: Right now, we do it on and off, so it’s hard to see any changes.

dialogue.content: でも、もう少し私が頑張れば、もしかしたら…と思います
dialogue.English: But I think if I just tried a little harder, maybe...

dialogue.content: でも、ホントに大変で
dialogue.English: But it's really so hard.

dialogue.content: お金もかかるし
dialogue.English: It costs a lot of money, too.

dialogue.content: すぐリタイヤしてしまい
dialogue.English: I give up so quickly.

dialogue.content: あー、私って駄目だ…
dialogue.English: Ah, I'm just no good...

dialogue.content: その繰り返しです
dialogue.English: It's just a cycle of that.

dialogue.content: ええ、これまでそうやって気を遣ってこられたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You've been so careful and considerate about this all this time.

dialogue.content: グルテンフリー の料理を調べたりするのですが、うちの子供達は食べそうもない料理とか
dialogue.English: I look up gluten-free recipes, but they're often things my kids probably wouldn't eat.

dialogue.content: パンも米粉パンは凄く手間がかかるので、嫌になります
dialogue.English: And making rice-flour bread takes so much effort that I just get fed up with it.

dialogue.content: もう食事の支度が苦痛になります。
dialogue.English: Preparing meals has become a pain.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうやっていろんなことに気を配って、考えて、行動して、、、日々の気疲れもすごいのではなでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, paying attention to so many things, thinking, and taking action... the daily mental exhaustion must be immense, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 凄く疲れます
dialogue.English: I'm extremely tired.

dialogue.content: 毎日3食の食事に気を配るなんて、本当にかなりの労力だと思います。
dialogue.English: To be so mindful of three meals every day, I think that takes a tremendous amount of effort.

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまうのも無理はないと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's completely understandable that you'd feel tired.

dialogue.content: やったりやらなかったりを繰り返してるので、効果があるか分からない…余計にやる気も出ません
dialogue.English: Since I keep going on and off with it, I don't know if it's even effective... which makes me lose motivation even more.

dialogue.content: 私はどうしたらいいのか…自分で分からなくなります
dialogue.English: I don't know what I should do anymore... I can't figure it out myself.

dialogue.content: 確かに進んでいる実感がないと、進むのもつらいですよね・・・。
dialogue.English: It's true, when you don't feel like you're making progress, it's hard to keep going...

dialogue.content: こういった話は誰かとされることはあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever talk about these things with anyone?

dialogue.content: 周りにグルテンフリー をしている人はいないので、あまり話さないですね。ですが、世の中の発達障害の子が良くなったという話を聞くと、やっぱり頑張ってやろうと思うんです
dialogue.English: There's no one around me who is doing gluten-free, so I don't talk about it much. But when I hear stories about children with developmental disabilities getting better, it makes me want to try harder.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうでしたか。じゃあ一人でずっと向き合ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been dealing with this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、主人とは話しますが、反対はされません。もし効果があっても、それを続けていかなきゃいけないと思うと、それも苦痛ですが…
dialogue.English: Yes, I talk to my husband about it, and he doesn't object. But even if it were effective, the thought of having to continue it forever is also painful...

dialogue.content: ええ、これまでの労力を考えると、しんどいですよね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, considering all the effort you've put in, that must feel exhausting...

dialogue.content: それでもこれまで休み休みでも続けてこられたのは、どういったお気持ちからだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even so, what has kept you going, even if on and off, all this time?

dialogue.content: 子供に少しでも良くなってもらいたいと思うからですね。
dialogue.English: It's because I want my child to get better, even just a little.

dialogue.content: ええ、やはりそこが一番大切ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's what's most important, isn't it?

dialogue.content: それほどまでに大事な存在なのですよね。
dialogue.English: That shows just how precious your child is to you.

dialogue.content: 物凄く状態が悪い訳ではないと思いますが、今より良くなって、少しでも生きやすくなれるなら、と思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think their condition is extremely bad, but I hope they can get better than they are now and find life a little easier.

dialogue.content: 少し前までは、死にたいと言っていました。本人にとって、生きにくい世の中なんです
dialogue.English: A little while ago, my child was saying they wanted to die. For them, it's a difficult world to live in.

dialogue.content: そのようなことを言われていたのですね・・・。
dialogue.English: So they were saying things like that...

dialogue.content: 今、中学生ですが、義務教育も辛い、楽しい事がない
dialogue.English: They're in middle school now, but they say compulsory education is hard and that nothing is fun.

dialogue.content: 親にとって、辛い言葉です
dialogue.English: For a parent, those are painful words to hear.

dialogue.content: はい、それを聞いたとき、すごく悲しかったですよね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, when you heard that, it must have been incredibly sad...

dialogue.content: その上、大好きなパンを取り上げては可哀想なので、たまには食べさせてやりますが、沢山食べると良くないと思って
dialogue.English: On top of that, I feel it's cruel to take away the bread they love, so I let them have it sometimes, but I worry it's not good if they eat too much.

dialogue.content: 板挟みみたいです
dialogue.English: I feel caught in the middle.

dialogue.content: もう本当にどうしたら良いなか
dialogue.English: I really don’t know what to do anymore.

dialogue.content: ええ、辛い思いをしているお子さんのために、少しでも何かできないかと、心を痛めながら進んでこられたのですね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, for your child who is suffering, you've been pushing forward with a heavy heart, wondering if there was anything, even something small, that you could do...

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ですが、私も疲れます
dialogue.English: But I get tired, too.

dialogue.content: はい、毎日のことですからそうなるのも無理はないと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a daily thing, so I think it's only natural you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: これまでの話をまとめさせていただくと、
dialogue.English: If I could summarize what we've talked about so far,

dialogue.content: 発達障害の子供のためにグルテンフリーの食事を心がけているが、金額的にも労力的にも大変で長続きしない。
dialogue.English: You're trying to maintain a gluten-free diet for your child with a developmental disability, but it's difficult to sustain due to the financial cost and effort involved.

dialogue.content: でも子供のためを思いまた始めるが、あまりおいしくないし高価だし子供も自分もつらい。
dialogue.English: But you start again for your child's sake, though the food isn't very tasty and it's expensive, which is hard for both you and your child.

dialogue.content: やったりやらなかったりで成果も目に見えてこず、やる気も出ず疲れる。
dialogue.English: Being on and off with it, you don't see any clear results, which drains your motivation and leaves you tired.

dialogue.content: それでも辛い思いをしている子供が少しでも楽に生きられるよう、これまで続けてきた。
dialogue.English: Despite all this, you've continued so that your child, who is having a hard time, might find life a little easier.

dialogue.content: ということであっているでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound correct?

dialogue.content: はい、その通りです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これまでお話を聞かせていただき、あなたが本当にお子さんを大切に想われているのがとてもよく伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, it has become very clear to me how deeply you care for your child.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お子さんからの言葉を聞いて、なおさら心配する気持ちも強くなっていたと思います。
dialogue.English: Hearing those words from your child must have heightened your worries.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。自殺してしまわないかと、心配になります。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. I worry that my child might commit suicide.

dialogue.content: ええ、だからこそこれまで必死の思いで進んできて、毎日気も張っていて心が疲れてしまったのかもしれないですね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, and that's precisely why you've been pushing forward so desperately, being on edge every day, and perhaps your heart has just grown tired...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: 本当に疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm truly exhausted.

dialogue.content: それでもお子さんを支えていきたい気持ちはきっと変わらないのだろうなと感じたのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: And yet, I sense that your desire to support your child hasn't changed. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 親である以上、ずっとそう思うのでしょうね
dialogue.English: As a parent, I suppose I'll always feel that way.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right...

dialogue.content: ただ今のままではあなたも疲れがたまってしまい、それをしていくことがどんどんつらくなっていってしまいそうだと感じました。
dialogue.English: However, I feel that if things continue as they are, your own exhaustion will build up, and it will become increasingly difficult to keep going.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。私の負担が大きいので、続かないと思います
dialogue.English: That's true. The burden on me is so great, I don't think I can continue.

dialogue.content: 変化が見られれば、また違っていたかもしれませんが。
dialogue.English: If I had seen changes, it might have been different.

dialogue.content: あと、経済的に負担もありますね
dialogue.English: And there’s the financial burden, too.

dialogue.content: はい、そこも大切な問題ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s an important issue as well.

dialogue.content: そして美味しくない！
dialogue.English: And it doesn't taste good!

dialogue.content: 美味しかったら、また違っていましたね
dialogue.English: If it were delicious, things would be different.

dialogue.content: ええ、きっと楽しみながらできましたよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you probably could have enjoyed the process.

dialogue.content: 今の方法もとてもいいと思うのですが、ほかにもお子さんのためにできることもあると思うのです。
dialogue.English: I think your current approach is very good, but I also think there might be other things you can do for your child.

dialogue.content: それは何でしょう？
dialogue.English: What would those be?

dialogue.content: 例えばお子さんの好きや興味のあることを見つけていくといった、それこそ一緒に楽しみながらできることもあると思います。
dialogue.English: For example, finding things your child likes or is interested in—that's something you could even enjoy doing together.

dialogue.content: きっとお子さんならではの個性があると思うので、そういったところをまずは見つけて伸ばしていくのもいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I'm sure your child has their own unique personality, so it might be good to first find those aspects and nurture them.

dialogue.content: 子供はゲームが好きで、たまに一緒にやります。と言うか、ゲームしかやる事が無いと言うか…
dialogue.English: My child likes video games, and sometimes we play together. Or rather, it feels like video games are the only thing they do...

dialogue.content: そういえば、最近、絵を描き始めました。
dialogue.English: Come to think of it, they've recently started drawing.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。素敵ですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, really? That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: で、絵を習う⁇って聞いたら、それは行きたくないと…
dialogue.English: So, when I asked if they wanted to take art lessons, they said they didn't want to go...

dialogue.content: そんな感じですかね？
dialogue.English: Is it something like that?

dialogue.content: 興味のある事を見つけるとは
dialogue.English: What you mean by finding their interests.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そういったものから見つかってくるものもあると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, yes, I think interests can be discovered from things like that.

dialogue.content: 絵は自分の心の表現でもありますので、教室に通わなくても自分の書きたいときに描くのがいいのかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: Drawing is also an expression of one's inner self, so perhaps it's best for them to draw when they feel like it, without having to attend a class.

dialogue.content: あ、そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: ゲームに関しても今はプロゲーマーというのもありますので、まだこれからどうなっていくのかが楽しみなところでもあると思います。
dialogue.English: As for gaming, there are professional gamers now, so it will be exciting to see where that might lead in the future.

dialogue.content: んー、心の表現になるかわからないですが…
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don't know if it's an expression of their inner self...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm.

dialogue.content: ゲームのキャラを描写してます
dialogue.English: They're drawing characters from video games.

dialogue.content: プロゲーマー、そこまでいくかわからないですが…
dialogue.English: A professional gamer... I don't know if they'll go that far...

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。ゲームと絵というものがつながって、お子さんの好きや興味が見つけられた感じのようですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It seems that games and drawing have connected, and you've found something your child likes and is interested in.

dialogue.content: 今、学校には行けてなくて、毎日ゲームですが、このまま様子を見ても大丈夫なんでしょうか…
dialogue.English: Right now, they aren't going to school and just play games every day. Is it okay to just wait and see how things go?

dialogue.content: そうですね、在宅学習で間に合うようならそれでもいいと思います。そういったことも一度学校に聞いてみるのもいいかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Well, if they can keep up with at-home learning, that could be fine. It might be a good idea to ask the school about that possibility.

dialogue.content: そうですね。一度聞いてみようと思います
dialogue.English: You're right. I think I'll ask them about it.

dialogue.content: こうやって一緒にお子さんの成長を楽しみながら見守るくらいの気持ちを持ってもいいのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Perhaps it's okay to allow yourself to just enjoy watching over your child's growth together like this.

dialogue.content: それでも今はこれまでの疲れもたまっていることと思います。
dialogue.English: Even so, I imagine you must have a lot of accumulated fatigue from everything up to now.

dialogue.content: グルテンフリー もほどほどにしてみようかなと思います。やっぱり美味しい食事が食べたいので…
dialogue.English: I think I'll try to do the gluten-free diet in moderation. After all, I want to eat delicious food...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうやって家族と食事を楽しむ時間も心のるリフレッシュにつながりそうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, enjoying mealtimes with your family like that could also lead to some mental refreshment.

dialogue.content: できる範囲で無理はしない方が良いですよね
dialogue.English: It's better not to push myself too hard and just do what I can, right?

dialogue.content: はい、これまでお子さんのために頑張ってきたあなただからこそ、少しでも自分の時間を持って、ゆっくり休む時間も作ってほしいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. Precisely because you've worked so hard for your child, I hope you can take some time for yourself and make time to rest.

dialogue.content: 今日は話したいことは話せた感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel like you were able to say everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます♪身体に良い物は取り入れて、でもできる範囲で考えていきたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll try to incorporate healthy foods, but I'll do it within a reasonable range.

dialogue.content: お話を聞いて頂いてスッキリしました
dialogue.English: I feel much better having had someone listen to me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました♪
dialogue.English: Thank you so much.

dialogue.content: はい、お子さんのことを何より大切に想えるあなたならきっとお子さんと寄り添いながら進んでいけると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, because you cherish your child above all, I believe you’ll be able to walk alongside them as you move forward.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ大切なお話聴かせていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you, as well, for sharing such an important story with me.

dialogue.content: それでは本日の相談は終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: With that, we’ll conclude today’s session.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ロープレの方も終了で大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we end the role-play now as well?

dialogue.content: はい、勉強になりました！ありがとうございました♪
dialogue.English: Yes, this was very educational! Thank you so much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you, as well. You did a great job. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: Thank you, you too.
